selection_rule: One V1 candidate per knowledge condition, one selection attempt per group, no tuning on Test; freeze V1 after selection. Drop a candidate only for answer leakage, absent injection, invalid format, or measured regression with clear causal evidence; keep inconclusive candidates and label them.
model_language: English for new prompts and output; Chinese reports
notes: Native SDK skills remain disabled; capability file is appended independently to the existing system prompt. CLI bridge and evaluator are reused.
budget_set_note: Set to 700000 before any extraction call after measuring the fixed cohort; same cap for K1/K2. No scores observed.
timeout_note: Actual text-call urllib timeout is1000s for both K1/K2. The initial protocol text said900s; corrected as documentation. Every extraction completed well below either limit.
